name: drugs in pregnancy and lactation overview
title: Whether a medicine is worth it in pregnancy or breastfeeding: in pregnancy most drugs are probably safe and the untreated disease is weighed against the drug, while a few major teratogens are switched or counselled on; in breastfeeding most drugs are safe if the relative infant dose is under 10 percent, a short list is contraindicated, and alcohol, tobacco, coffee and cannabis each have their own rule

root.title: A medicine in pregnancy or breastfeeding: is it worth it?
lines: most drugs reach the baby, and most are still safe · always weigh the risk of the UNTREATED disease
the risk depends on the drug, the dose, the timing and her disease

groups.title: PREGNANT: the placenta is NOT a barrier
lines: timing of exposure: see the ANTENATAL CARE chart

groups.title: BREASTFEEDING: how much reaches the baby, and can the baby clear it?
lines: most drugs cross into milk, in minute amounts
